en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a smiling woman standing outdoors in a rural setting. She is dressed in traditional folk costume, featuring intricate embroidery, and is carrying two large containers balanced on a wooden yoke across her shoulders. In the background, there are haystacks, a wooden cart wheel, and a rustic thatched structure, suggesting a village or farming environment. The text at the bottom is in Bulgarian and German, indicating the subject relates to folk costumes from Sofia.
